archetypes.name: dyn-stall-report-env
archetypes.rationale: Tier A report key normalization feeds /design fallback routing.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Tier A stall report dedup path and its regression coverage. Focus on whether helper stdout is normalized into STALL_RECOVERY_REPORT_* keys without breaking dry-run, helper-missing, no-match, and lookup-failed-open routes. Check that issue URL alias emission matches the shared normalizer contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
